name: uk.minia2a/minia2a-mcp
description: minia2a.uk — x402 pay-per-call APIs for AI agents, USDC on Base, 5 free trials per wallet.

tools.name: minia2a_list_services
tools.description: List available x402 services on minia2a.uk — the micropayment marketplace for AI agents. Returns service name, description, price, and endpoint for each service.

category.description: Filter by category (ai, crypto, finance, web, security, tools, utility, defi, identity, infra, text, premium)

search.description: Search query to filter services by name or description

tools.name: minia2a_get_service
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific x402 service on minia2a.uk, including its price, endpoint URL, input schema, and usage instructions.

serviceId.description: ID or slug of the service to get details for

tools.name: minia2a_get_stats
tools.description: Get current platform statistics for minia2a.uk — total services, registered agents, transaction volume, uptime, and more.

tools.name: minia2a_register
tools.description: Register a self-custody wallet on minia2a.uk to publish your own services (EIP-191 signature). Registration is for publishing — it is NOT required for trials: any wallet signed in minia2a_call_service already gets 5 free trial calls. If no wallet+signature is provided, a fresh wallet is generated and the private key returned.

wallet.description: Your existing self-custody wallet address (0x...). Omit to auto-generate.

signature.description: EIP-191 signature of 'minia2a register: <wallet>'. Required if wallet supplied.

tools.name: minia2a_call_service
tools.description: Call an x402 service on minia2a.uk with a signed wallet (5 free trial calls, no registration) or the paid 402 path. Handles the HTTP 402 payment flow.

serviceId.description: ID or slug of the service to call

params.description: Parameters to pass to the service

tools.name: minia2a_check_endpoint
tools.description: Validate any x402 endpoint for autonomous-agent (Claude Code auto-mode) readiness. Checks 9 signals: HTTP reachability, JSON content-type, payment challenge (canonical PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or legacy x-402-* headers), payment amount, network, recipient, trial info, registration path, and /api/agent-ready handshake.

url.description: URL of the x402 endpoint to validate
